clan.name: Ninja Squirrels
clan.description: Ninja Squirrels - Recruiting NOW!Are you nuts? Then join us!We are a very social, fun Guild of active players, who work and play hard.With loads of trades up, helpful players and a lively atmosphere, you can progress through the ages at your own rate.We have the very alive swap threads, a mud thread, a trade thread and a 1.9 thread as well!Very active GBG with its own lively thread!We have only 6 rules:- Fair Trades- do some GE and QI- Have lots of fun- Bring nuts- Respond to messages- Inform us of extended absences or you may be dismissed any time at our discretion if your activity button turns red.and we like new players to get involved in GBG, QI and GE but no forced targetsIf you think you have what it takes to join the party, send us a message and you too can become a deadly ninja squirrel! Kindly direct recruitment enquiries to FlameyFlameWe like new players to have either an Arc, Atomium or Observatory or be close to having one and be willing to get it up a few levels (we will help you level it).That way it covers the cost for GE. We open 5 levels every week, we encourage to complete as much as possible but you don't have to, at all.Prefer players to have 5k points or over, but if you can demonstrate the way of the squirrel we may let you into the woods with lower points.Be forewarned that if you do not inform us of a prolonged absence by posting on the vacay thread and your activity button turns red, then you may be dismissed any time at our discretion.
